module_summary: Direct-mapped ARP cache: LFSR CRC hashes of IP addresses index valid/IP/MAC memories for registered query lookups and writes, with a sequential clear sweep.

anchors.name: query_request_valid
anchors.why: Query request valid; accepted query latches IP and hashed read pointer.

anchors.name: query_request_ip
anchors.why: IP address to look up; hashed by rd_hash and stored in query_ip_reg.

anchors.name: query_response_valid
anchors.why: Response valid output from query_response_valid_reg after lookup.

anchors.name: query_response_mac
anchors.why: Looked-up MAC address read from mac_addr_mem.

anchors.name: query_response_error
anchors.why: Miss indication: set when entry invalid or stored IP mismatches query IP.

anchors.name: write_request_valid
anchors.why: Write request valid; latches IP/MAC and hashed write pointer.

anchors.name: write_request_mac
anchors.why: MAC address to store, latched into write_mac_reg.

anchors.name: write_request_ip
anchors.why: IP address key for write, hashed by wr_hash and latched.

anchors.name: query_request_ready
anchors.why: Query ready, deasserted while clearing or response stalled.

anchors.name: write_request_ready
anchors.why: Write ready, deasserted during cache clear.

anchors.name: clear_cache
anchors.why: Clear command: resets write pointer and starts invalidation sweep.

anchors.name: clear_cache_reg
anchors.why: Clear in progress: increments wr_ptr, writes invalid entries, blocks requests.

anchors.name: ip_addr_mem
anchors.why: Stored IP tags compared against query IP for hit detection.

anchors.name: mac_addr_mem
anchors.why: Stored MAC addresses read out as query response.

anchors.name: valid_mem
anchors.why: Per-entry valid bits; cleared by sweep, checked on lookup.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Hashed read index into cache memories for queries.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Hashed write index; also sweeps all entries during clear.

anchors.name: query_request_hash
anchors.why: CRC hash of query IP from rd_hash LFSR, low bits form read index.

anchors.name: write_request_hash
anchors.why: CRC hash of write IP from wr_hash LFSR, low bits form write index.

anchors.name: query_ip_valid_reg
anchors.why: Query pending flag; triggers response generation next cycle.

anchors.name: query_ip_reg
anchors.why: Holds query IP for tag comparison against ip_addr_mem.

anchors.name: write_ip_valid_reg
anchors.why: Write pending flag; asserts mem_write next cycle.

anchors.name: write_mac_reg
anchors.why: Holds MAC to write into mac_addr_mem.

anchors.name: write_ip_reg
anchors.why: Holds IP to write into ip_addr_mem.

anchors.name: mem_write
anchors.why: Write enable for valid/IP/MAC memories (write or clear sweep).

groups.name: Cache memories
groups.description: Direct-mapped valid, IP tag and MAC arrays indexed by hashed pointers.

groups.name: Query path
groups.description: Hashes query IP, reads entry, compares tag, returns MAC or error.

groups.name: Write path
groups.description: Hashes write IP, latches IP/MAC, writes entry at hashed index.

groups.name: Clear controller
groups.description: Sweeps wr_ptr through all entries clearing valid bits, blocking requests.
